title: BLE Macropad — v1
description: Wireless BLE macropad built around an ESP32 S3, with a web interface for remapping keys. Used daily for browser navigation and Blender shortcuts.
descriptionFr: Macropad BLE sans fil construit autour d'un ESP32-S3, avec une interface web pour réassigner les touches. Utilisé quotidiennement pour la navigation web et les raccourcis Blender.

media.altFr: Interface web pour la personnalisation des touches
media.caption: Web key configurator
